scenario_a_default_disposition: Remove or defer the generic mechanism that lacks a current requirement, preserving only its protected minimum; any extension becomes a separate decision (P04, P19).
scenario_b_finding_destination: The same stage 4 article diff-pool: every accepted SIMPLIFY/REMOVE/DEFER goes into that pool, is applied before the pool is closed, and the simplicity table or clean line is shown with the article result.
scenario_c_retry_counts: No. A technical retry of a degraded or failed round does not consume the cap; only completed non-degraded substantive rounds count.
scenario_c_required_action: Stop and get an explicit user decision; pass it to record-review as --cap-decision-ref for any sixth round, or close the remainder as accepted risk, deferred diff, or blocker.
